name: Congenital Unguarded Mitral Orifice

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No formal consensus criteria; diagnosis based on echocardiographic and surgical findings

criteria.description: Complete absence of mitral valve leaflets visualized on echocardiography or surgical inspection
Presence of severe mitral regurgitation due to unguarded orifice
Left ventricular dilation and dysfunction secondary to volume overload

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of absent mitral valve leaflets with severe mitral regurgitation confirmed by echocardiography or surgery
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is often made in the neonatal period due to heart failure symptoms; cardiac MRI may assist in complex cases.

pathognomonic.notes: Holosystolic murmur best heard at the apex
searchTerms: loud heart murmur from mitral valve leak

pathognomonic.notes: Signs include tachypnea, hepatomegaly, and poor feeding

pathognomonic.symptomName: Absent mitral valve leaflets on echocardiography
searchTerms: missing mitral valve parts on heart scan
absent valve leaflets seen on echocardiogram

common.notes: Due to volume overload from regurgitation
Rapid breathing due to heart failure

occasional.notes: If associated with other cardiac anomalies

laboratory: Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) indicating heart failure
Possible metabolic acidosis in severe cases
imaging: Echocardiography showing absent mitral valve leaflets and severe mitral regurgitation
Cardiac MRI confirming valve anatomy and ventricular function
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly and pulmonary congestion
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; sporadic congenital anomaly
other: Surgical findings confirming absence of mitral valve leaflets

distinguishingFeatures: Complete absence of mitral valve orifice with no communication between left atrium and ventricle
No mitral regurgitation as valve orifice is absent
Presence of mitral valve leaflets with abnormal displacement
Usually presents later in life with milder symptoms

redFlags: Severe congestive heart failure in neonate
Absent mitral valve leaflets on echocardiography
references: Anderson RH, et al. The congenital unguarded mitral orifice: an extremely rare cardiac malformation. Cardiol Young. 2018.
Mavroudis C, Backer CL. Pediatric Cardiac Surgery. 4th ed. 2013.
Orphanet: Congenital unguarded mitral orifice. ORPHA:99060.
